verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM's pricing page says its workflows automate routing leads to the right rep, so automatic lead routing is directly claimed. But this is a single marketing line, with no documentation of assignment rules, round-robin distribution, or how owners are chosen. missing for 10: documented assignment-rule configuration, round-robin distribution, owner-selection criteria, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can route new leads to the right owner automatically with assignment rules or round-robin

citations.quote: Automate repetitive tasks with workflows. From routing leads to the right rep to updating fields when a deal is closed.
